motivation: Banks give bigger limits to clients with a track record
if_lower: Low: a small limit; a newer or riskier client

what: Months, out of the last 6, with a payment delay of 1 month or more
motivation: Repeated late payment is the strongest predictor of default
if_higher: 2 or more: a pattern of late payment

what: Longest payment delay in the last 6 months, in months
motivation: A 2-month delay is far more serious than a 1-month slip
if_higher: 2 or more: seriously behind at some point

what: Payment delay in the latest month (September 2005), in months
motivation: Being behind right now matters most

what: Latest bill divided by the credit limit
motivation: Clients near their limit have little room to absorb a shock

what: Average bill over 6 months divided by the credit limit
motivation: Sustained high use is riskier than a one-off

what: Months, out of 6, in which the bill exceeded the limit
motivation: Going over the limit signals stress
if_higher: 1 or more: went over the limit

what: Latest payment divided by the previous month's bill (capped at 2)
motivation: Clients who pay only a sliver of the bill are carrying debt
if_higher: Near 1 or above: pays the bill in full
if_lower: Near 0: pays almost nothing of the bill

what: Average of payment divided by the previous bill, over 5 months (capped at 2)

motivation: Paying in full is the strongest sign of low risk
if_higher: 3 or more: often pays in full

what: Months, out of 6, with status -2 (commonly read as no balance to pay)
motivation: An unused card carries little risk but also little history
if_higher: High: the card is mostly unused

what: Months, out of 6, with status 0 (commonly read as revolving credit: paid the minimum, not behind)
motivation: Revolving clients carry balances but are not late
if_higher: High: carries a balance month to month

what: Change in the bill over 6 months (latest minus oldest) divided by the limit
motivation: Rising balances can signal trouble before payments are missed

what: Average payment in the last 3 months minus the 3 months before, divided by the limit
motivation: Shrinking payments can come before a default
